info.title: Dexxify API
info.description: Crypto Infrastructure API for Africa (Wallets, Payouts, Offramp, Onramp, KYC, KYB)

password.description: User password — min 8 characters, must include at least one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +2348065924354

example: amount must not be less than 0

new_password.description: New password — min 8 characters, must include at least one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character

business_id.description: ID of the business workspace to activate

type.description: static_deposit_address issues a crypto address; ngn_virtual_account issues an NGN bank account

bvn.description: BVN of the account holder (11 digits). Required when type is ngn_virtual_account

narration.description: Optional note that appears on bank statement

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value data to attach to the customer

first_name.description: First name to match against record

last_name.description: Last name to match against record

selfie.description: Base64-encoded selfie image for facial match

validation.description: Optional fields to validate against the BVN record
Optional fields to validate against the NIN record
Optional fields to validate against the vNIN record

registration_name.description: Registered business name for additional matching

recipient_id.description: CC recipient ID for the bank account to receive NGN payout.

is_active.description: Whether the webhook endpoint is enabled

title.description: Session title shown on the checkout page

description.description: Session description shown on the checkout page

crypto_asset.description: Crypto asset (locks asset for this session)

network.description: Blockchain network (locks chain for this session)

customer_email.description: Customer email to link this session to

network.description: Blockchain network to generate address on

slug.description: Custom slug. Auto-generated from title if omitted.

refundAddress.description: Customer wallet address to receive the refund

feePaidBy.description: Who pays the blockchain fee. Defaults to merchant settings.

recipient_id.description: CC recipient ID for the destination bank or wallet

token.description: Invitation token from the email link

password.description: User password — min 8 characters, must include at least one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character
